result.note: A thin item. It tests only the status of two bills at the start of the July 2026 Monsoon Session.

questions.prompt: Parliament opened its Monsoon Session on 21 July 2026. Consider the following statements about two bills at the start of that session:
items: The bill to remove ministers held in custody for 30 days had cleared committee and was advancing.
A rewrite of foreign-funding rules was advancing.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The bill to remove ministers held in custody for 30 days stayed stuck in committee, so statement 1 is wrong. The foreign-funding rewrite was the one advancing, and the custody bill was described as the more contentious of the two.
questions.source: a bill to remove ministers held in custody for 30 days stayed stuck in committee
